statement: For every symmetric binary99x99 zero-diagonal matrix A with exactly14 ones in each integer row, put M=A^2+A+J over GF(3), E0=0 and Ek=ker((M-I)^k) for each integer k>=1. Every quotient Ek/E(k-1) has even GF(3) dimension; each eigenvalue1 Jordan block size has even multiplicity, dim ker(M-I) is even, and rank(M-I) is odd. This supplies no target resolution or incidence-rank upper bound.
